text:
mira: Quick design review - the small docs panel label is inconsistent (Docs panel / Help drawer / Guides). We should pick one and update cross-links.
kai: Prefer 'In-product docs' for consistency with research. Also question: glossary clicks currently open the docs site in a new tab. Should we support inline preview anchors?
jess: Accessibility: panel traps focus but doesn't restore it on close. Links inside collapsed sections are not keyboard-focusable. Need tabindex + aria fixes and contrast bump.
rahul: Docs infra: not all pages have stable anchors. If we do inline previews, we need canonical IDs or fallback to full page. Linker can return anchor or full URL.
design-bot: Anchor audit: 5 important pages missing anchors under /docs/serve and /docs/opt. Recommend adding id attributes.
mira: microcopy proposal: canonical name = "In-product docs"; CTAs = "Learn more" for full pages, "Definition" for inline hits. Agree?
jess: +1 and I'll file a small PR for focus restore, aria-expanded/controls, and link contrast.
kai: I'll update routing: show inline mini-preview when anchor exists, otherwise open full page in new tab. Emit events: docs_panel_open, docs_inline_preview, docs_external_open.
rahul: I'll patch top 10 pages this sprint with anchors and add tests in linker-service for fallback behavior.
mira: Action items: jess -> a11y PR; kai -> routing + analytics; rahul -> anchor rollout plan; design -> update figma. Target: small patch by end of sprint. Thanks.
